enunciado: Write a program that shows two lines: "Hola, mundo" and "InvenioLang". Each print writes exactly what it receives; the line break is written as "\n".
objetivos: Know the minimal structure of a program (void main)
Use print and the \n line break
pistas: Every program starts running in main.
print("text") does not add a line break on its own.
Add print("\n") or include \n inside the text.
